prompt: A diazonium salt (ArN₂⁺) can be used to install which groups? (pick the FULL list)

options.label: Cl (CuCl), Br (CuBr), CN (CuCN), OH (H₂O/heat), H (H₃PO₂), F (HBF₄/Δ)

explanation: Diazonium salts are enormously versatile: Sandmeyer (Cu-based: Cl/Br/CN), Schiemann (F via ArN₂⁺BF₄⁻ then heat), reduction with H₃PO₂ (H replacement), and H₂O/heat for OH.
